turns.text: Why isn't it exactly half every time?

turn.asked: Why isn't it exactly half every time?
turn.reply:
That's a great question! With 1000 tosses, you'd expect around 500 heads, but it's very unlikely to be exactly 500. Randomness means the actual count wobbles a bit — you might get 487 or 512 or something close but not exactly half. The more tosses you make, the closer the fraction gets to 1/2, but it rarely lands right on the dot.

Now, take a look at the three options on the board and pick the one that matches that idea.
